      Best time to meet

      9-to-5 working hours in New York and Bangalore do not overlap at all, so someone has to meet outside their usual hours. Suggested slot: 7:00 AM in New York = 5:30 PM in Bangalore.

      Time difference and daylight saving time

      In January: Bangalore is 10.5 hours ahead of New York. In July: Bangalore is 9.5 hours ahead of New York. From November 7, 2027 to December 31, 2027, the clocks change on different dates and the gap is temporarily 10.5 hours.

      New York changes its clocks on March 14, 2027; November 7, 2027. Bangalore does not change its clocks in 2027.
